description: This file implements the TraceControl plugin for the WPEFramework, managing trace output, configuration, and remote control via HTTP requests.

classes.name: TraceControl
classes.description: Main class implementing trace control functionalities, including initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and dispatching trace information.

classes.name: TraceControl::Observer
classes.description: Observer class managing remote trace modules and categories, handling start/stop observation, and setting trace states.

classes.name: TraceControl::Data
classes.description: Data structure representing trace configuration and status information.

methods.name: TraceControl::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the TraceControl plugin, setting up configuration, output targets, and starting observation.

methods.name: TraceControl::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters observers, and stops trace observation.

methods.name: TraceControl::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; here, it returns null indicating no additional info.

methods.name: TraceControl::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; no action needed as no request bodies are expected.

methods.name: TraceControl::Process
methods.description: Processes HTTP GET and PUT requests to retrieve or modify trace settings.

methods.name: TraceControl::Dispatch
methods.description: Outputs trace information to configured trace media outputs.
